artworks.title: Fantastic River Landscape with Ruins and a Castle
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed view of an architectural structure, with bricks and intricate details suggesting a classic or historic style. Closest to us are architectural fragments like a column and a stone block at the base of the building. In the distance, there are rolling hills, buildings, and a tower with a flag. The etching features controlled lines depicting both architectural and natural elements with a monochrome palette. Some foliage is seen draping the top of the structure.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with a Triumphal Arch
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural setting featuring classical ruins. The drawing depicts an elaborate archway with intricately designed columns and a coffered ceiling. Large urns adorn the niches within the arch. In the background, there are more remnants of ancient architecture, including a partly collapsed building and classical columns. The scene is set against a mountainous landscape under a lightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Castle and a Drawbridge
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval scene with a focus on architecture. A grand castle wall with a turret and arched entrance is featured to the left, detailed with brickwork and crenellations. A narrow bridge connects the castle to the landscape with other structures visible in the distance. Gently rolling hills mark the horizon, adding depth. On the right, a textured tree frames the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white with fine lines for texture. The scene illustrates a balance between natural and artificial elements through precise etching techniques.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with Portals and Monuments
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows an architectural drawing from a ground-level perspective, featuring classical columns and ornate structures. A large pedestal with spherical decorations is centered. The horizon includes distant mountains, buildings, and architectural elements. The style is defined by intricate linework, engravings, depth, and texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray and black. Steps lead to the columns and stonework, with brickwork and decorative elements framing the scene. Smaller buildings and arches are visible in the distance, adding depth.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with a Fountain, Classical Ruins, and a Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows classical architectural elements viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. On the left is an ornate fountain with water cascading into a basin. In the center, tall columns and architectural structures with detailed carvings are framed. On the right is another substantial architectural feature, possibly a large archway. The horizon, defined by arches and ruins, creates a sense of depth. The artwork is characterized by precise and linear brushstrokes typical of etching, with fine lines and crosshatching for detail. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a cream background. The composition balances the architectural elements with the natural surroundings, creating a harmonious blend.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with Buildings, Stairways, and Portals beside a Canal
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural scene with columns, archways, a waterway, stone walls, and a bridge. The perspective highlights the grandeur of the structures. Fine lines suggest wispy clouds against a clear sky. The detailed line work creates texture and depth, emphasizing the architectural details.

artworks.title: Shepherds in a Landscape before a Fortified Town
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 26.9 x 40.5 cm (10 9/16 x 15 15/16 in.)
support: 33.6 x 45.6 cm (13 1/4 x 17 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sweeping landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is on the upper left, dividing the earth from the sky. The painting is detailed with various textures and a soft sepia color palette. In the forefront, there are people guiding cattle and a seated figure. Further back, there is a bridge, towers, and a castle-like structure surrounded by trees. On the right, there is a small hill with trees framing the side.

artworks.title: Vulcan and the Cyclopes Forging Arrows
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing several muscular figures, potentially mythological characters, engaging in physical labor. The foreground depicts nude individuals wielding large hammers or tools, while another figure holds a massive beam. In the background, there are classical architectural elements and smaller figures performing various tasks, creating a dynamic composition. The detailing includes intricate musculature, facial expressions, and object textures.

artworks.title: Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a person facing slightly to the left. The individual has a prominent nose, full lips, and a beard and mustache. The hair is partially covered by a cap, appearing curly. The person wears historical clothing with a visible collar and a cloak or robe. No jewelry or objects are held. The background is textured with text mentioning 'Hanns Holbein' and additional notations.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ascension scene. The drawing depicts a central figure, surrounded by others, seemingly ascending into the sky. The composition includes a crowd below, amidst a landscape with trees and clouds. The central figure is highlighted by lines suggesting rays of light. Around this figure are other characters engaged in various poses, observing, gesturing, or resting. The background features detailed natural elements like trees with intricate foliage and clouds. The style is reminiscent of classical religious or historical drawings, displaying careful line work to convey form and expression.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of figures beneath a celestial vision. The scene is filled with many figures, some seated or kneeling, engaged in various activities or in conversation with each other at the lower part of the composition. Above them, surrounded by clouds, is a central heavenly figure surrounded by winged cherubs. The detailed line work represents texture and depth, as seen in the foliage of trees and the clouds. The drawing features intricate detailing on the garments of the figures, with emphasis on folds and flowing lines. The composition is balanced with a combination of natural elements like trees and fantastical elements like the figures in the clouds.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image displays a person in an upper body view. The person has their head tilted down, resting their cheek on their right hand. They have distinct facial features, deep-set eyes, and long hair flowing under a hood. The person is wearing a coat with visible button details on the sleeves. One arm is extended forward, resting on a surface with the other arm. The background is textured and shaded to give depth to the artwork.

artworks.title: A Capriccio of Roman Ruins
artworks.description: This painting shows classical ruins illuminated by sunlight. A bright blue sky is visible beyond aged red and gray arches covered with green plants. On the right is a tall gray statue of a horse and rider surrounded by broken columns. In the center, people stand and sit among the ruins, gesturing to each other. On the left, water drips down the steps of a large carved fountain with a broken roof. More statues, stairs, and arches are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper (backed with eighteenth century paper)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures, both human and a cow, in a rural setting. One person is seated, holding a child, with most of their body shown. Another figure is leaning on a staff, facing downward, with short wavy hair and simple clothing. A third figure stands behind them. A cow with horns is on the left. The scene is sketched in brown ink wash, depicting a barn-like environment with few details.

artworks.title: Dionysian Revelers
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk on green wove paper
artworks.description: The image features two women shown from the waist up. The woman on the left has her face visible in profile, with her hair styled in an up-do with a decorative piece, likely a hair pin. She wears earrings and an off-the-shoulder dress with draped sleeves and a fitted bodice. Her body is angled to the left with her right arm raised above her head and left arm extended outwards. The woman on the right is shown from the back, with her head slightly turned and hair in a bun. She holds a shallow bowl with both hands raised to shoulder height and wears a loose-fitting, off-the-shoulder garment. The background is plain, on neutral beige paper.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Bids Farewell to his Father
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring a group of elegantly dressed individuals engaging in conversation. An additional figure is visible in the background. The image depicts a detailed and ornately bordered tableau with four figures gathered around a seated person. Another figure in the background is carrying a large object on their back and is entering from an exterior setting. A pastoral landscape with trees, buildings, and animal figures can be seen through an open architectural space framed by columns. The figures are clothed in period attire, suggestive of a historical or allegorical theme. The intricate detail of the lines suggests a careful etching or engraving process. The image includes elaborate decoration within the main scene and in the border, highlighting architectural and natural elements with a rich texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son in a House of Ill-Repute
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures engaged in conversation. The drawing depicts a domestic setting with various figures around a table. The table is set with a cloth and has books or objects placed upon it. A large window in the background shows a view of a landscape with buildings and a cloudy sky. The room has architectural elements like columns and an archway leading to another room. In the adjacent room, a figure appears to be working near a hearth. The scene includes intricate detailing in the clothing, furnishings, and a decorative dog on the floor. The style resembles possibly 17th-century European art, showcasing domestic life and interior spaces with rich details.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son as a Swineherd
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a young shepherd sitting against a detailed landscape. The shepherd is portrayed with a pastoral staff and looking upwards, surrounded by trees. In the background, there is a field with grazing livestock such as pigs and a donkey. The sky above has soft clouds and birds in flight. The trees are depicted with intricate cross-hatching, adding texture to the scene. The artwork has a monochromatic color scheme of gray and brown, resembling an ink drawing or etching. Ornate borders with floral motifs frame the composition.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Received by his Father
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a scene set in a classical architectural setting. In the foreground, there is an ornate frame enclosing the image. On the left side, a woman in elaborate attire stands near a column, holding a fan and gazing towards two figures on the right. She is dressed in detailed, flowing garments typical of the period and adorns an elaborate hairstyle. 

Central to the drawing are two figures embraced in a reunion. The elder figure, wearing a long robe and a hat, embraces the younger one who is kneeling, while a small dog appears excited, and a cherub-like figure stands next to a balustrade, holding a musical instrument. The background features a detailed landscape with trees and cloudy skies, enhancing the classical ambiance. The verses written at the bottom suggest a story of reconciliation or forgiveness.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son's Father Orders the Best Robe and the Slaughter of the Fatted Calf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of people interacting indoors. The scene shows a richly detailed interior setting with a large window, ornate decorations, and architectural features like columns. The foreground features a seated individual interacting with three standing figures in elaborate attire. The background includes more architectural and decorative elements. The drawing is enclosed by a decorative border with intricate designs, all rendered in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: The Feast Celebrating the Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate interior scene with people dining. The drawing depicts a gathering in a room with detailed architectural elements such as columns and windows. The background features intricate wallpaper with nature motifs and a chandelier hanging from the ceiling. The setting shows a large table with various items, suggesting refinement and splendor. The artwork's framing is detailed with decorative patterns highlighting the opulence of the scene.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Bids Farewell to His Father
artworks.artist: Theodoor van Thulden after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting featuring a horse. The drawing shows a central figure on horseback who is being addressed by another figure in robes while other figures stand around observing the interaction. The architecture in the background includes a grand archway and a window with a third figure looking out. The horse is elaborately saddled and appears in mid-step. The scene also includes textures in the clothing, masonry, and sky, contributing to the overall depth and dynamism of the composition.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Receiving His Patrimony
artworks.artist: Theodoor van Thulden after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an interior scene with historical or mythological figures. The image features several figures engaged in various activities. There is a prominent figure in elaborate clothing with a plumed hat at the center. To the left, a group of individuals surround a table, appearing to be engaging in discussion. On the right, a kneeling figure is reaching into an open chest. The background is richly decorated with drapery and patterns. Another figure in the background is drawing curtains open to reveal a stately alcove. The drawing is characterized by fine lines with detailed cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Wasting His Substance in the Tavern
artworks.artist: Theodoor van Thulden after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group engaging in music and conversation. The scene depicts several figures arranged in a lively setting. A seated figure on the left plays a stringed instrument. Other figures are standing or seated around this musician, interacting with gestures that suggest conversation or listening. The clothing, drapery, and detailed background convey sophistication, possibly depicting an interior scene with classical or Renaissance influences. In the background, various architectural elements and decorative features, such as columns and intricate ceiling patterns, add depth and context to the image.
